documents.title: Shareholder Meeting / Postal Ballot-Outcome of AGM
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome

analysis.summary: Lumax Auto Technologies reported a strong start to FY 2027 with Q1 revenue growing 33% year-on-year to INR 1,364 crore and EBITDA expanding 51% to INR 205 crore. Management highlighted a robust order book of INR 1,600 crore and ongoing capacity expansions across various divisions including Mechatronics and IAC. While remaining watchful of macroeconomic uncertainties, the company maintained its long-term vision of achieving a 20% revenue CAGR from 2025 to 2031. The management expressed confidence in sustaining current operating margins and meeting full-year capex and financial targets. Lumax Auto Technologies Limited reported consolidated revenues of INR 1,364 crores for Q1 FY27, representing a 33% increase year-on-year.

guidance.claim: The company expects the effective tax rate to remain around 25% going forward.
guidance.quote: The effective tax rate continues to remain at around 25%, which is also expected to hold at similar levels way forward.

guidance.claim: Management anticipates the share of minority interest to stay within 11% to 13% based on the existing structure.
guidance.quote: The share of minority interest for Q1 stood at 12% after the strategic consolidation at the standalone level, which is expected to be in the similar range going forward considering the existing structure.

guidance.claim: The full-year capex guidance remains around INR 300 crore.
guidance.quote: The guidance for the full year continues to remain around INR 300 crore, which will include the upcoming greenfield expansions of Mechatronics as well as new plants of IAC division.

guidance.claim: The company maintains its long-term 20% revenue CAGR vision from 2025 to 2031.
guidance.quote: In the long term, our compass remains our “20.20.20.20 Vision”, aiming for a 20% revenue CAGR from 2025 to 2031, inching closer to 20% EBITDA margin over the next 5 to 7 years.

guidance.claim: Management expects to more than double the revenue base to upwards of INR 10,000 crore by FY 2031.
guidance.quote: And by FY 2031, we aspire to more than double our current revenue base to upwards of INR 10,000 crore, fueled by a blend of organic excellence and strategically inorganic opportunities.

guidance.claim: The company targets a minimum revenue CAGR of 20% under its next mid-term plan for FY26 to FY31.
Management stated a vision for EBITDA margin of 20% in the mid-term plan.
The company targets 20+% from future and clean mobility under its mid-term plan.
Management expects to continue outperforming industry growth by 2x to 3x across various businesses.
guidance.quote: I think a few of the businesses we are looking at perhaps doubling that of industry growth, growing by 2x. And in certain business cases, we might as well also grow by 3x of the industry growth on account of various initiatives like value content going up or wallet share expansion.

guidance.claim: The company remains on par with its mid-term strategy targeting a 20% CAGR over the next 3 to 5 years.
guidance.quote: So overall, I think we continue to be on par with the mid-term strategy of our 20% CAGR over the next 3 to 5 years.

guidance.claim: The effective tax rate for FY 26 is 26%, and management expects it to hold at similar levels going forward.
guidance.quote: Excluding the same, the effective tax rate for FY 26 comes out as 26%, and we expect it to hold at similar levels way forward.

guidance.claim: The minority share for FY 26 is at 17%, and is expected to be in a similar range going forward.
guidance.quote: The minority share for FY 26, however, is at 17%, and which is expected to be in a similar range going forward.

guidance.claim: Management expects full-year margins to sustain or increase by at least 30 bps.
guidance.quote: So for the full year, I do not foresee any reason that the margins would get negatively impacted. On the contrary, I would say, on account of the top line growth, the margin should just sustain or at least further go up by at least 30 bps or so.

guidance.claim: Lumax Ituran's FY 27 guidance projects up to 150 basis points improvement in EBITDA level.
guidance.quote: However, the FY 27 guidance remains in place for up to 150 basis points improvement as is being projected internally right now.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand is expected to remain healthy heading into the festive season with low inventory levels reported by leading OEMs.
demand_outlook.quote: As we enter the festive season, demand is expected to remain healthy, with many leading OEMs (Original Equipment Manufacturers) reporting low inventory levels.

demand_outlook.claim: The overall demand environment and industry outlook continue to be favorable, providing near-term confidence.
demand_outlook.quote: While we remain watchful of the macroeconomic uncertainties, commodity inflation and the energy price volatility, the overall demand environment and industry outlook continues to be favorable, giving us confidence for the near term.

demand_outlook.claim: The aftermarket segment is confident in posting double-digit growth for the remaining part of the year.
demand_outlook.quote: However, we are confident to bounce back and confident to post double-digit growth for the remaining part of the year in this particular segment.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the overall demand environment and industry outlook continues to be favourable as they enter FY 27.
demand_outlook.quote: while we remain watchful of the macroeconomic uncertainties, commodity inflation and the energy price volatility, the overall demand environment and industry outlook continues to be favourable, giving us confidence as we enter FY 27.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand from a retail point of view still seems to be intact.
demand_outlook.quote: However, of course, there are certain input costs and margin pressures. But the demand from a retail point of view, still seems to be intact.

demand_outlook.claim: CNG continues to have a very strong pull in the market.
demand_outlook.quote: So CNG continues to have a very strong pull in the market.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated they do not see CNG demand to be slowed down for this sector.
demand_outlook.quote: We don't see that to be slowed down for this sector.

capex_expansion.claim: A new plant is being set up at Chakan for the IAC division to cater to Mahindra & Mahindra.
capex_expansion.quote: • A new plant at Chakan for the IAC division to cater to upcoming demand from Mahindra & Mahindra, while simultaneously optimizing product lines between this facility and the existing ones.

capex_expansion.claim: The mega Mechatronics plant in Manesar is expected to be commissioned by Q3 of the year.
capex_expansion.quote: • The previously announced mega Mechatronics plant in Manesar, Haryana is expected to be commissioned by Q3 of this year, where we are consolidating four entities, Lumax Yokowo, Lumax Alps Alpine, Lumax Ituran and Lumax FAE, under one roof to optimize resources and fixed costs.

capex_expansion.claim: A new facility is being set up in Nashik to cater to requirements after onboarding Mahindra as a Greenfuel Energy customer.
capex_expansion.quote: • At Greenfuel Energy, we are pleased to report that we onboarded Mahindra as a new customer and to cater to their requirements, we shall be setting up a new facility in Nashik.

capex_expansion.claim: Capital expenditure during the first quarter was INR 23 crore.
capex_expansion.quote: The capex during the 1st Quarter was INR 23 crore.

capex_expansion.claim: The company recorded a capex of INR 23 crores in Q1 FY27.
Total capex during the year was INR 233 crore, including strategic land investments and capacity expansions.
capex_expansion.quote: The capex during the year was INR 233 crore, which included strategic investment in land in Gujarat and Kharkhoda Region of INR 45 crore and also almost INR 100 crore on capacity expansions in IAC and Lumax Alps Alpine.

capex_expansion.claim: Total capex for the year is projected to be anywhere between INR 275 crore to INR 300 crore.
capex_expansion.quote: and it is reflected in our capex plans for the year, which Ankit had mentioned, it would be anywhere between INR 275 crore to INR 300 crore.

margins_costs.claim: Management states that current margins achieved in Q1 will be sustained for the remaining part of the year.
margins_costs.quote: On the margin front, I think I can only say that we will be able to sustain these current margins achieved in Q1 for the remaining part of the year as well.

margins_costs.claim: Inflationary costs and minimum wage hikes have put short-term pressure on margins.
margins_costs.quote: all of it has, of course, put some short-term pressure on the margins.

margins_costs.claim: The company has a back-to-back understanding with OEMs with a lag of 3 to 6 months for price realizations.
margins_costs.quote: It is just a lag of about 3 to 6 months depending on the OEM by when we get these realizations.

orders_capacity.claim: The company reported an order book of INR 1,600 crore.
orders_capacity.quote: We are pleased to report a robust order book of INR 1,600 crore, which provides a healthy visibility for the business going forward.

orders_capacity.claim: Approximately 24% of the order book is expected to be executed in FY 27, 56% in FY 28, and 20% in FY 29.
orders_capacity.quote: Of this order book, approximately 24% is expected to be executed in this FY 27 itself, 56% in FY 28, and the remaining 20% in FY 29.

orders_capacity.claim: The Advanced Plastics division holds an order book of INR 787 crore.
orders_capacity.quote: The order book remains strong at INR 787 crore for this division, providing solid future visibility.

orders_capacity.claim: The Mechatronics segment has an order book close to INR 500 crore.
orders_capacity.quote: The Mechatronics segment sustained its upward momentum, delivering a y-o-y increase of almost 56% in Q1 FY 27 from INR 54 to INR 84 crore, with a very healthy order book of close to INR 500 crore.

orders_capacity.claim: The Structure and Control Systems vertical has an order book of INR 130 crore.
orders_capacity.quote: It reported a y-o-y growth of 21% in Q1, increasing from INR 180 crore to INR 220 crore with an order book of INR 130 crore.

orders_capacity.claim: The Alternate Fuels business reported an order book of INR 200 crore.
orders_capacity.quote: The Alternate Fuels business showed a growth of 17% y-o-y from INR 95 to INR 111 crore with an order book of INR 200 crore.

orders_capacity.claim: The total order book is scheduled to progress in stages and achieve full completion by FY29.
orders_capacity.quote: The order book is set to progress in stages achieving full completion by FY29.

orders_capacity.claim: The company operates 28 manufacturing facilities across 7 states.
Advanced plastics contributed the largest share of the order book, followed by Mechatronics, alternate fuels and Structures & Control Systems.
orders_capacity.quote: The order book continues to reflect a healthy traction across all our product verticals with advanced plastics contributing the largest share, followed by Mechatronics, alternate fuels and Structures & Control Systems.

orders_capacity.claim: The Advanced Plastics division order book remains strong at INR 700 crore.
orders_capacity.quote: The order book remains strong at INR 700 crore, providing solid future visibility.

orders_capacity.claim: The Mechatronics segment has a healthy order book of INR 400 crore.
orders_capacity.quote: The Mechatronics segment sustained upward momentum, delivering a y-o-y growth of almost 150% in FY 26 from INR 115 crore to INR 281 crore with a healthy order book of INR 400 crore.

capital_allocation.claim: Free cash reserves stood at INR 415 crore as of June 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: Free cash reserves stood at INR 415 crore, providing us with the financial flexibility to support ongoing investments and navigate market cycles confidently.

capital_allocation.claim: Long-term debt stood at INR 508 crore, resulting in a conservative debt-to-equity ratio of 0.32.
capital_allocation.quote: The long-term debt stood at INR 508 crore, resulting in a conservative debt-to-equity ratio of 0.32, which is within our internal comfort thresholds.

capital_allocation.claim: The majority of the INR 300 crore capex will be funded from internal accruals.
capital_allocation.quote: The majority of the capex, INR 300 crore, will continue to fund from the internal accruals.

capital_allocation.claim: About 10-12% of capex specific to a particular JV or subsidiary will be funded via debt.
capital_allocation.quote: However, around 10-12%-odd, the capex, which is more specific towards any particular JV and or the subsidiary, for that very specific purpose a debt will be taken.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board approved the sale of the entire 50% equity stake in Lumax JOPP Allied Technologies to JOPP Holding Germany.
capital_allocation.quote: The Board has also approved the sale of entire 50% equity stake in Lumax JOPP Allied Technologies Private Limited to JOPP Holding Germany, the Joint Venture partner, subject to completion of customary conditions in terms of the share purchase agreement.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board approved a proposal to acquire the remaining 15.97% stake in Lumax FAE Technologies from existing shareholders.
capital_allocation.quote: The Board has also approved proposal to acquire the remaining stake of 15.97% in Lumax FAE Technologies Private Limited, from its existing shareholders.

capital_allocation.claim: Free cash reserves stood at INR 396 crore as of March 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: Free cash reserves stood at INR 396 crore, providing us with the financial flexibility to support ongoing investments and navigate market cycles confidently.

capital_allocation.claim: CRISIL upgraded the company's credit rating from AA- to AA.
capital_allocation.quote: In my closing, I would also like to highlight that during the year, CRISIL upgraded the Company's credit rating from AA- to AA, reflecting strong financial strength, prudent capital management and sustained business performance.

capital_allocation.claim: The company maintains an internal dividend payout policy of a minimum 35% payout ratio.
capital_allocation.quote: So the payout ratio, we have a very fair internal policy of maintaining a minimum 35% payout ratio and the Company continues to maintain that for the year.

risks_headwinds.claim: The global economy navigates geopolitical challenges including the Middle East conflict, impacting energy security and supply chains.
risks_headwinds.quote: The global economy continues to navigate a challenging geopolitical landscape with the ongoing conflict in the Middle East, heightening concerns around energy security, supply chain disruptions, and inflationary pressures.

risks_headwinds.claim: The industry continues to closely monitor commodity prices, geopolitical developments, and supply chain dynamics influencing input costs.
risks_headwinds.quote: The industry continues to closely monitor commodity prices, geopolitical developments and supply chain dynamics that could influence input costs and overall market sentiment.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted short-term pressure on margins due to inflationary costs in raw material commodities, manpower costs, and energy prices.
risks_headwinds.quote: So Amit, most of the inflationary costs, be it on account of raw material commodities or also the manpower cost, which has significantly risen up due to certain minimum wage hikes, also the energy price is going up, all of it has, of course, put some short-term pressure on the margins.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management acknowledged that labour shortages occurred due to elections, war-related scenarios, or other conditions.
risks_headwinds.quote: So yes, it is very much a fact and there is no point saying that there are no labour shortages that we have experienced either due to elections or due to the war-related scenario or other conditions.

management_commitments.claim: The company aims to achieve a 20% revenue CAGR from 2025 to 2031.
management_commitments.quote: In the long term, our compass remains our “20.20.20.20 Vision”, aiming for a 20% revenue CAGR from 2025 to 2031, inching closer to 20% EBITDA margin over the next 5 to 7 years.

management_commitments.claim: Management aspires to more than double the current revenue base to upwards of INR 10,000 crore by FY 2031.
management_commitments.quote: And by FY 2031, we aspire to more than double our current revenue base to upwards of INR 10,000 crore, fueled by a blend of organic excellence and strategically inorganic opportunities.

management_commitments.claim: The company targets a minimum 20% revenue CAGR from organic and inorganic sources through FY31.
The company remains committed to executing its mid-term strategy to evolve from a traditional Tier 1 supplier to a Tier 0.5 system integrator.
management_commitments.quote: At Lumax Auto Technologies, we remain firmly committed to the execution of our mid-term strategy backed by a robust order pipeline, a diversified customer base and a very well-defined road map to evolve from a traditional Tier 1 supplier to a Tier 0.5 system integrator

management_commitments.claim: IAC would definitely see an expansion on its OEM customer base over the mid-term plan of 2030.
management_commitments.quote: So I still remain pretty optimistic that over our mid-term plan of 2030, IAC would definitely see an expansion on its OEM customer base.

management_commitments.claim: Full year debt repayment starts from FY 27 onwards.
management_commitments.quote: And accordingly, their repayment or I would say, the full repayment is starting from this year onwards.

management_commitments.claim: The current debt will automatically die down in the next 3 to 4 years.
management_commitments.quote: And considering the balance payment, I think in next 3 to 4 years, I think the current levels of debt or the loan which is there will automatically die down.

management_commitments.claim: Lumax Ituran will enter the SOP of a brand-new telematics product in another 3 months.
management_commitments.quote: Also happy to confirm to you that in another 3 months from now, we will be getting into the SOP of a brand-new product at Lumax Ituran, which is at a significantly higher margin, which will be the second product in the telematics category to be included.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
